input_manifest.record_source: synthetic fixtures — not real observation data

real_data_note: No local snapshot of the 337 historical observations exists in either sporely-py or sporely-web. The 337/227/87/23 counts originate in scripts/taxonomy-v2/run-sparse-registry-experiment.mjs as generate_series constants. The disposable simulation applies the desktop fixture manifest only.

simulation.isolation: disposable local schema; drop-and-recreate at start; never touches supabase/migrations or production

non_integration.notes: Integration tests skipped when no local Supabase target discoverable; run with W2D_INTEGRATION=1 against an OrbStack-hosted local supabase to execute them.

verdicts.idempotency: asserted by test 'idempotency — applying the fixture manifest twice yields identical row counts and snapshot fingerprint' (integration; skipped without local supabase)
verdicts.rollback: asserted by test 'rollback simulation leaves zero orphan rows' (integration)
verdicts.snapshot_preservation: asserted by test 'later exact resolution preserves the original snapshot verbatim' plus 'snapshot immutability trigger rejects direct UPDATE to original_*' (integration)
verdicts.out_of_cache_materialisation: asserted by test 'out-of-cache concept materialises with scope_state=required_ancestor' (integration)
verdicts.manifest_shape_conformance: verified in non-integration test 'every manifest record carries the contract §6 field set'
verdicts.semantic_sha_verification: verified in non-integration test 'semantic SHA-256 helper matches the desktop-published hash'
